question: The Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (MRTP) Act was introduced during the _________ Five-Year Plan period.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fourth**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (MRTP) Act** was enacted in **1969** and came into force on **June 1, 1970**. This timeline aligns with the **Fourth Five-Year Plan**, which was implemented from **1969 to 1974**.

• The **Fourth Five-Year Plan** was launched under the Prime Ministership of **Indira Gandhi** and was based on the **Gadgil Strategy**. It focused on **growth with stability** and the progressive achievement of **self-reliance**. The introduction of the **MRTP Act** was a crucial legislative measure during this plan to ensure **social justice** and prevent the concentration of economic power.

• The act was drafted based on the recommendations of the **Dutt Committee** (also known as the **Industrial Licensing Policy Inquiry Committee**) and the **Mahalanobis Committee**.
